summary: The reimagining of Dark Yugi's Duelist Kingdom deck: Black Luster Soldier and Magician of Black Chaos return as a dual-purpose Ritual series. One Ritual Spell summons either boss monster and keeps recurring itself, while Mind Shuffle (a Continuous Trap, not a Spell) loops resources between the two. Real, confirmed Tier 1: Shinon went 7-2 for 1st place at the Teiryu Cup (3v3 team format, 64 teams / 192 players) piloting this archetype, and it was the 3rd-most-played CORI-relevant deck in the OCG's Apr–Jun 2026 season (96 of 1,084 tracked Top-cut decks).

cards.name: Ritual of Light and Darkness
cards.effectText: This card can be used to Ritual Summon "Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos" or "Black Luster Soldier – Soldier of Light and Darkness." Tribute monsters from your hand/field, and/or banish monsters from your GY, whose total Levels equal or exceed the Ritual Monster's Level. If this card is in your GY: add this card and 1 card that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your GY to your hand. Once per turn.

cards.name: Black Luster Soldier – Soldier of Light and Darkness
cards.effectText: Ritual Summon with "Ritual of Light and Darkness." Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects unless they target this card, and cannot be destroyed by battle. Each of the following once per turn: if this card is Special Summoned, target 1 card your opponent controls and banish it. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: this card gains 1500 ATK, and if it does, it can make a second attack in the same Battle Phase.

cards.name: Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos
cards.effectText: Ritual Summon with "Ritual of Light and Darkness." Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects unless they target this card. Spells/Traps you control cannot be destroyed or banished by your opponent's card effects. Each of the following once per turn: if this card is Special Summoned, add 1 Spell from your GY to your hand. Target 1 card your opponent controls and banish it face-down.

cards.name: Skull Archfiend of Chaos
cards.effectText: If this card is in your hand or GY: target 3 other cards in either GY and/or face-up banishment (including a card that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual"); place them on the bottom of the Deck in any order, and if you do, Special Summon this card. If this card is sent to the GY: send 1 Ritual Spell from your hand/Deck to the GY, then add 1 Ritual Monster named on that Spell from your Deck to your hand. Each effect once per turn.

cards.name: Mind Shuffle
cards.effectText: During either player's turn: add 1 monster that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. When your opponent activates a card or effect: return 1 Level 7 or higher monster you control to the hand; Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your hand with a different name than the returned monster, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You cannot activate both effects in the same Chain. Each effect once per turn. Corrected card type — this is a Continuous Trap, not a Normal Spell as originally previewed.

cards.name: Griffoh
cards.effectText: (Quick Effect) You can discard this card, then either: the next battle or effect damage you would take this turn becomes 0; OR Set 1 Quick-Play Spell/Trap that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your Deck, and it can be activated this turn. Once per turn. If you Ritual Summon exactly 1 Level 8 Ritual Monster with an effect that requires Tributing monsters, this card in your hand or GY can be used as the entire Tribute.

cards.name: Black Chaos the Ultimate Magical Swordsman
cards.effectText: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Can be Special Summoned (from your hand) by shuffling 1 Spellcaster or Warrior Ritual Monster from your hand or GY into the Deck; once per turn this way. You can discard this card: place 1 Continuous Trap that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your Deck or GY face-up on the field (i.e. this fetches Mind Shuffle). Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects while you have a Ritual Spell in your GY. Once per turn: banish 2 cards your opponent controls.

comboLines.title: Mind Shuffle grind loop
comboLines.body: Send Skull Archfiend of Chaos to the GY to send Ritual of Light and Darkness to the GY and tutor a Ritual Monster, then get Mind Shuffle face-up (via Griffoh's Set-and-activate-this-turn effect, or via Black Chaos the Ultimate Magical Swordsman discarding to place it) to start recurring Ritual pieces and swapping between your two boss Ritual Monsters. Swap into Black Luster Soldier – Soldier of Light and Darkness for offense (battle-destruction snowballs into a second attack) or Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos for protection/removal, depending on board state.

comboLines.title: The dominant OCG variant splashes "Fallen"/Branded
comboLines.body: Per OCG tournament tracking, the highest-representation Light and Darkness Ritual builds this season aren't the pure engine shown here — they splash a Fallen of the White Dragon/Branded-style package (roughly 30 of 45 tracked LADR decks in one May 2026 snapshot) to add more ways into a Level 8 Ritual Monster and additional grave-set value. This site's sample list below sticks to the pure engine plus generic staples, since the exact splash package/counts couldn't be verified reliably from this environment — worth researching further if you want to build the more-played variant before NAWCQ.

sampleDecklist.label: Confirmed real Tier 1: Shinon went 7-2 for 1st place at the Teiryu Cup (3v3 team format, 192 players) piloting Light and Darkness Ritual. This list is the pure engine (all 7 archetype cards) plus a standard generic staple shell — it is NOT the "Fallen"/Branded-splash variant that's most common in the current OCG metagame (see combo notes above); treat this as a solid, honest starting point rather than the exact meta list.
